messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: nuts non-diag algorithm
parts:
Overall, Yuanjun's code looks great for nuts_nondiag.

I updated the manual. I removed the givenmass version for now.
(We can add it back in later if we need it -- if we do, it'll
need to have its I/O unified with everything else and we should
implement it along with nuts_nondiag.)

I was a bit confused about why the mass matrix isn't involved
in the momentum calculation. Did it get sucked into some
other term? If Yuanjun's around, I'm sure he can explain.
Michael -- did you look at nuts_nondiag and see if it'd fit
in your new scheme?

It looks like the updates to the estimates are done every sample,
not every leapfrog step above the slice. If so, can
we just delete the commented out code where nuts_diag did it
per step?

Also, you don't need to sign your comments -- they should be there
for everyone.

Are all the change comments like "change summation to expectation"
things I shouldn't worry about? If so, can we eliminate them?

- Bob

messages.author: ace9745b50e86915
messages.subject: Re: nuts non-diag algorithm
parts:
Hi, Bob

The mass matrix isn't involved in the momentum calculation because we are actually not using the momentum but some transformation of the momentum.

Updates is done at every sample because I always feel that doing it at every slice won't give a consistent estimation. But actually I am not sure

Sorry about signing the comments, I just want to tell which comment is written by myself when performing the coding
